title: hm2mqtt Home Assistant settings per device and channel
description: Overrides --ha-channel-devices: per device address how its channels are split, per channel address whether it is published to Home Assistant and where it goes. A channel not listed follows its device, the device follows --ha-channel-devices.

split.description: off: one Home Assistant device; children: the channels as child devices (Home Assistant 2026.11+); devices: the channels as devices of their own

publish.description: false: not published to Home Assistant (its MQTT topics stay)

device.description: on the device, a child device of it, or a device of its own
